audit.whatIsWrong: The level-1-2 spike claims Renekton lands an 'empowered W' combo at level 1.
audit.why: Reign of Anger: 'Renekton's attacks generate Fury.' He starts a game at zero, so the empowered Ruthless Predator (>50 Fury: three slashes, 1.5s stun instead of 0.75s, destroys damage shields) is not available until he has autoed. The Fury bar is the tell, and that is the actionable version of the same advice.
audit.corrected: Spike now keys off the Fury bar: half a bar means the 1.5s stun is loaded; empty means 0.75s and your Q-poke wins.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single biggest interaction in this matchup was absent: empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target. Also, the page named almost none of Renekton's abilities.
audit.why: Riot on Ruthless Predator: 'If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.' Hero's Entrance grants allies a magic shield — that shield is exactly what an empowered W deletes. Ability names verified: Reign of Anger, Cull the Meek, Ruthless Predator, Slice and Dice, Dominus.
audit.corrected: Shield-destroy stated in mid, tradeBad, the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions; real names used throughout; Cull the Meek's heal named as the anti-heal target.

edits.before: Renekton owns the first two levels outright — his empowered W stuns and a Slice-and-Dice dash let him land a full point-and-click combo before you even have Justice Punch, so don't walk up to last-hit inside his fury range. Soak Q poke at max range with Winds of War and farm patiently; at level 1 you have no engage and no escape from his step-up. The lane flips at level 3: once Justice Punch and Shield of Durand are up, bait his W, channel Shield of Durand to eat the empowered hit, then taunt on the release and E-knockup him as his fury dumps.
edits.after: Renekton owns the first two levels, but only once he is empowered: Ruthless Predator needs 50 Fury, and Fury comes from autos, so him hitting the wave up to half a bar is the tell that the 1.5-second stun is loaded instead of the 0.75-second one. Soak that window at max range with Winds of War and farm patiently; at level 1 you have no engage and no escape from his step-up. The lane flips at level 3: once Justice Punch and Shield of Durand are up, bait the W, charge Shield of Durand to eat the empowered hit, then taunt on the release and E-knockup him as his Fury dumps.

edits.before: From 4-5 onward his cooldowns no longer outpace yours, and every time he commits fury you can channel Shield of Durand through the chunk and taunt him standing in your tornado. At 6 you don't need to win the straight 1v1 — Hero's Entrance lets you flag a roam or counter-dive bot and swing the map while his early lead has nowhere to go. Note that Shield of Durand's reduction is only heavily amplified against magic, and Renekton is pure AD, so lean on the base reduction and the taunt timing rather than expecting the channel to negate the whole combo — hold W until you see the empowered animation or he just walks out of the taunt.
edits.after: From 4-5 onward his cooldowns no longer outpace yours, and every time he dumps Fury you can charge Shield of Durand through the chunk and taunt him standing in your tornado. At 6 you don't need the straight 1v1 — Hero's Entrance flags a roam or counter-dive and swings the map while his early lead has nowhere to go. Two things to respect: Shield of Durand's reduction is only heavily amplified against magic and Renekton is pure AD, so lean on base reduction and taunt timing rather than expecting the charge to erase the combo; and his empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields, so the Hero's Entrance shield you drop on an ally is not safe from it.

edits.before: This is fully yours. Renekton has no sustained threat once survived — his kit is front-loaded fury burst that your MR, HP and Shield of Durand soak, and he brings nothing to a teamfight that your W taunt and Hero's Entrance engage don't beat. Dropping Hero's Entrance onto his backline, then taunting on landing, is a multi-man swing he can't replicate. Just don't get caught split-pushing alone before your team groups, because finding a solo pick is the only job he has left.
edits.after: This is fully yours. Renekton has no sustained threat once survived — front-loaded Fury burst that your MR, HP and Shield of Durand soak, and Dominus is bonus health and an aura, not something your W taunt and Hero's Entrance can't beat. His one sustain lever is Cull the Meek's heal, so an Oblivion Orb keeps the maths yours. Dropping Hero's Entrance onto his backline, then taunting on landing, is a multi-man swing he can't replicate. Just don't get caught split-pushing alone.
